notices.text: Per-shower translated frame: 2 event(s), 4 showers superimposed at their own entry points. ⟨ρ⟩ is energy per event and per mm², so it sums both showers of an event.

No cell-footprint comb measured on the raw per-shower translated accumulation grid, before any display smoothing (worst lag-1 per axis: Δx +0.06, Δy −0.10); each cell's footprint is integrated exactly by area-weighted box overlap.

Bins below 10⁻³ of ρ_ref are not drawn (ΔxΔy 312 bins holding 0.178% of its in-window energy; ΔyΔz 576 bins holding 0.383% of its in-window energy; ΔxΔz 571 bins holding 0.366% of its in-window energy), so the outer edge of the colour is the display floor, not the edge of the shower. Bins with no energy at all are empty.

Colours are relative to this selection's own peak density on the raw 20 mm accumulation grid (stated in the panel's Details drawer), which the displayed field never exceeds; switch the density normalisation to the dataset peak to compare colours across selections.
With 2 event(s) the fitted display ranges and the mean centroids rest on weak evidence and are labelled provisional.

truth_voxel.label: Ground truth (voxel-weighted)
truth_voxel.offset_note: A-B offset of the two superimposed ensemble centroids in the ΔxΔy plane, each relative to its own shower's entry point: not a separation, which is D, the absolute-frame 3-D centroid distance.

pred_voxel.label: Model prediction (voxel-weighted)
pred_voxel.offset_note: A-B offset of the two superimposed ensemble centroids in the ΔxΔy plane, each relative to its own shower's entry point: not a separation, which is D, the absolute-frame 3-D centroid distance.

frame_mean.label: Mean per-event centroid (centroid_*_trans), relative to each shower's entry point
frame_mean.dof_note: N = 2: SD with ddof = 1 and a Student-t 95% interval on 1 degree(s) of freedom; weak evidence, labelled provisional.

centroid_dataset.label: Dataset centroids (absolute-frame per-event average; not drawn in the per-shower translated frame - see centroids.frame_mean)

coherence.note: The per-shower translated frame does not rotate, so every shower keeps its absolute-frame incident direction and the azimuth keeps its absolute-frame distribution (resultant length above): no averaged direction is drawn. Individual trajectories are drawn from the origin for at most 50 events.

slab.note: The ΔxΔy panel sums each shower's entrance slab: its own first 6 sampling layers (123 mm), counted from the layer holding its entry point.

frame.anchor_note: Each hit is shifted by its own shower's entry point P0 - the energy-weighted x, y centroid of that shower's first populated layer, at that layer's depth. D (the slider) is the absolute-frame 3-D centroid distance.

depth.text: each shower's own sampling layers counted from its first, never smoothed

window.planned_from: dataset energy-weighted 10⁻⁴ and 0.9999 quantiles plus half a footprint

fit.note: Display windows are symmetric about the origin along Δx and Δy, each half-width covering the 0.1st to 99.9th energy percentile, never below 200 mm (a provisional one-shower floor), and snapped outward to whole 20 mm bins. Up to 0.086% of a panel's energy lies outside its window on the raw accumulation grid; it is excluded from the view but not from the statistics. Depth is never cropped. With 2 co-registered event(s) the fitted ranges are provisional.

coordinates.note: Coordinates: the file's own x/y_trans and the own-shower layer, as every response of this frame binned them; the same motion (the shower's entry point P0 subtracted from the laboratory position) was applied to every hit inside the scan as a cross-check, and over this selection the two differ by at most 3.44e−05 mm (ingest-wide 6.1e−05 mm), within the 0.01 mm tolerance.

comb.measured_on: raw accumulation grid, before display smoothing
comb.note: No cell-footprint comb measured on the raw per-shower translated accumulation grid, before any display smoothing (worst lag-1 per axis: Δx +0.06, Δy −0.10); each cell's footprint is integrated exactly by area-weighted box overlap.

rho.basis: peak of the raw 20 mm accumulation grid of this selection, before display reconstruction

reconstruction.label: none (raw bins)
reconstruction.depth: each shower's own sampling layers counted from its first, never smoothed
reconstruction.note: Native Grid: the raw 20 mm accumulation bins with no reconstruction, the audit view. Total transverse blur including the exact area-weighted overlap of each cell's footprint and the 20 mm binning: 16.2 mm RMS in Δx, 16.2 mm in Δy.

reach.note: Relative layer k + 1 lies inside the detector for a shower whose first populated layer is the physical layer s when s ≤ L_phys − 1 − k, with L_phys = 58 layer slots of 20.5 mm from z = 3662.4 to 4830.9 mm and s = round((P₀z − 3662.4 mm) / 20.5 mm); counts[k] is how many of the selection's 4 showers A and B reach it.

depth_layers.note: Relative layers 1–58, counted from each shower's own first populated layer (relative layer 1 at Δz = 0); seams at (k − ½) × 20.5 mm, the last group running to the end of the axis.
